background: Coventry Building Society is the second-largest UK building society after Nationwide, a mutual funded by retail savings and lending almost entirely on residential and buy-to-let mortgages, and the owner of The Co-operative Bank.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the society, A- on average, one on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook, after a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 16 Sep 2026 and a move to positive outlook by one on 23 Oct 2026. Capital is strong on a risk-weighted basis, with CET1 of 19.6% in the top quarter of UK building societies, but leverage of 4.8% is in the bottom quarter, the figure to watch. Liquidity is a strength, with LCR of 232% in the top quarter and NSFR of 147% above the median. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 has fallen 1.6 points, leverage 0.5 points and LCR 19 points.
